name: mango
description: Mango turns Chinese finance jargon into plain language: looks up terms, decodes news, compares two options, breaks down money decisions and questions sales pitches. Explains and helps you tell things apart, never gives buy or sell advice.

displayDescription.en: Turns investing jargon into everyday Chinese. Looks up a 1000+ term dictionary, decodes finance news, compares two options, questions sales pitches and breaks down personal money decisions. Always explains, never advises.
displayDescription.zh: 把投资的词翻译成人话：查词条、拆新闻、比方案、防话术坑、拆财务决策，只帮理解与分辨，不给买卖建议。
